name: net_hidden_tab_back_through_a_rejoin
description: Client 2's tab is hidden for 15 s and its link drops meanwhile, so when the tab is shown it comes back through the reconnect path: a resume HELLO, RESYNC(rejoin) from the latest checkpoint, and the catch-up (no checkpoint is kept meanwhile: client 1's uploads go up spoilt, so the catch-up starts well back). The tab's own return does not start a second catch-up over the rejoin's: the rejoin's re-run sends its HASHes from the checkpoint on (none is held back), so the rejoined state is checked as it runs, and they agree.

steps.msg: a checkpoint past tick 0 is kept
shown, it found its link gone, reconnected and rejoined

steps.assert: caught_up and (from_tick == kept_tick) and (goal == scene.client(2).resyncs[0][2] * 3) and (goal > from_tick + 600) and scene.client(2).sent_hashes.has(from_tick + 60) and scene.client(2).sent_hashes.has(from_tick + 120)
steps.msg: the rejoin's catch-up kept its goal, the open turn, and its re-run sent its HASHes from the checkpoint on: no second catch-up held them back or cut the goal short
every hash from the checkpoint on agrees
